services.name: Tabletop Exhibits
services.desc: The world’s largest hockey collection awaits - from access to the Stanley Cup to artifacts dating back to the game’s origin up to and including this current season. Go one-on-one against life-size, animated versions of today's greatest goalies and shooters, call the play-by-play of some of hockey's greatest goals and take the hot seat as a television anchorperson. We were interactive before interactive was interactive! Enjoy our newest humourous spot.
